lines.japanese: ふう、今日は実に楽しかった。実に薔薇色な一日だった。
lines.english: Whew. Today had been tremendous fun. A truly rose-colored day.

lines.japanese: とと、今日はまだ終わってないんだった。そう、俺はある決意を胸に秘めて我が家へ帰ってきた。
lines.english: Wait, today wasn't over yet. I had returned home with a certain resolution hidden in my heart.

lines.japanese: それは今朝方決めた、小鳩の視野を広げるために対人関係を増やすこと。
lines.english: I had decided that morning to expand Kobato's relationships so she could broaden her perspective.

lines.japanese: 彼女が兄離れしたら寂しくはなるが、しかし、それを乗りこえてこそ真実の愛はあるはず。
lines.english: I would be lonely if she grew independent of her brother, but surely true love waited on the other side of that trial.

lines.japanese: というわけで、小鳩を他の男に会わせるなど不安や不服はあるが、とりあえず俺の友人代表をひとり連れてきた。
lines.english: And so, despite all my anxieties and objections to introducing Kobato to other men, I had brought home one representative of my circle of friends.

lines.japanese: 題して、小鳩の世界を広げちゃうぞシリーズ！
lines.english: I called it: Operation Broaden Kobato's World!

lines.japanese: 羽田の叔父さん叔母さんは共働き。つまりこの時間なら、俺と小鳩と客人と、三人だけで話が出来るのだ。
lines.english: Uncle and Auntie both worked. In other words, at this hour, Kobato, our guest, and I could talk alone together.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの、それではお茶をどうぞ」
lines.english: “U-um, here's your tea.”

lines.japanese: 「はァ～イッ！　いっただっきまーすっ！　アニキから夕ごはん誘われちゃって、ヤスオ感激ィ～ッ！」
lines.english: “Thaaanks! Don't mind if I dooo! Bro invited me to dinner, and Yasuo is over the moooon!”

lines.japanese: 「カ、カノジョさんだと思ってたら、妹さんだったのねェ～ん！　んーも、久しぶりィーんっ！　ブリブリィーんっ！　ブブブぶリィ～んっ！」
lines.english: “I thought you were his girlfriend, but you're his little sisterrr! Long time no seeee! Poo-poo-pooo! P-p-p-pooo!”

lines.japanese: 「は、はい。一度見たら忘れないキャラだと思っていました」
lines.english: “Y-yes. I remember thinking you were the sort of person no one could forget after meeting once.”

lines.japanese: 俺が今日連れてきたのはＲ－ウィングの咲夜こと佐久間安男。
lines.english: Today's guest was Yasuo Sakuma, better known as Sakuya of R-Wing.

lines.japanese: なぜ彼を選んだかと言えば、小鳩と一応は面識もあり、歳も近くて話しやすかろうと思ってのことだ。
lines.english: I chose him because he and Kobato had at least met before, and being close in age might make him easy for her to talk to.

lines.japanese: 「そういや妹さんのお名前まだ窺ってなかったよネッ！　あっなたっのおっなまえ、なんてーのッ！？　ブシャアーッ！」
lines.english: “Come to think of it, I never asked your naaame! Whaaat might your naaame beee?! Splaaat!”

lines.japanese: 「も、もうこのくらいで」
lines.english: “Th-that's quite enough.”

lines.japanese: 「ウッシャシャシャ！　俺もうアニキに誘われたから、気合い入れてお肉まで用意してきちゃったもんねえーッ！　うちの冷蔵庫に入ってた特上ロース、好きなだけ焼いて食って焼いて焼いて焼いて食っちゃって！」
lines.english: “Ush-sha-sha-sha! Bro invited me over, so I got all fired up and even brought meat! This top-grade loin was in our fridge. Grill all you want, eat all you want, grill it, grill it, grill it, eat it!”

lines.japanese: 「え、え、お肉ですか。ああ、ありがとうございます」
lines.english: “M-meat? Oh. Thank you very much.”

lines.japanese: おっ？　他人様の家へ遊びに行く時は差しいれを持って好感度アップか？
lines.english: Oh? Bringing a gift when visiting somebody's home to raise your approval rating?

lines.japanese: やるな佐久間安男、小鳩に好印象じゃないか。
lines.english: Well played, Yasuo Sakuma. He was making a fine impression on Kobato.

lines.japanese: なにっ！　小鳩に好印象だと！？
lines.english: What?! A fine impression on Kobato?!

lines.japanese: ふざ、ふざ、ふざけやがって、このＯＩＫが！　いかんいかん、こうなったら、なんとしても佐久間安男の評価を下げなくては！
lines.english: Y-you have got to be kidding me, you AOB! No, wait. At this rate, I had to lower Yasuo Sakuma's standing by any means necessary!

lines.japanese: 「こんなおいしそうなお肉をありがとう、佐久間君。だけど勝手に持ってきたりして、お母さんから怒られないかなあ？」
lines.english: “Thank you for bringing such delicious-looking meat, Sakuma. But won't your mother be angry that you took it without asking?”

lines.japanese: 「ブシャシャ、そォ～んなんアニキが気にしなくていいんだってェ！　アニキと彼女さんの血となり肉となるなら、俺を世間の目で縛ろうとする二匹の奴隷も満足すると思うよ？　思うよアヴァヴァヴあ゛あ゛あー！」
lines.english: “Bwee-hee-hee! Brooo, you don't gotta worry about thaaat! If it becomes flesh and blood for you and your lady, I'm sure those two slaves who bind me in the chains of society's gaze will be satisfied! I’m sure! I’m suuure! B-b-b-blaaaargh!”

lines.japanese: 「わっ、ほんとにいいお肉だあ。お兄ちゃん、これお父さんとお母さんも喜ぶと思うよ」
lines.english: “Wow, it really is good meat. Big Brother, I bet Mom and Dad will be happy too.”

lines.japanese: 「マぁ～ジかよォ～！　だったら俺もう、アニキのうちの子になっちゃおっかなぁ！　あはぁ～ん」
lines.english: “Are you seeerious?! Then maybe I'll just become a son of this hooouse! Ah-haaan!”

lines.japanese: 「なにィッ！？」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: うちの子になるということは、つまり小鳩の婿になる気かこいつ！
lines.english: Become a son of this house? In other words, he intended to marry Kobato!

lines.japanese: 「あれッ？　どしたのアニキ、怖い顔してェ～？　せっかくのお肉パーティー楽しもうじぇいっ！　じぇいじぇいっ！」
lines.english: “Huh? What's wrong, Brooo? Why the scary face? Let's enjoy our meat partyyy! Party, party!”

lines.japanese: 「おっ、お肉パーティーだと！？　て、テメエ、うちの小鳩になにするつもりだ！」
lines.english: “A m-meat party?! Y-you bastard! What do you intend to do to my Kobato?”

lines.japanese: 「なにって、お肉をぺろっと食べちゃうだけだよ？」
lines.english: “What? I'm just gonna gobble up the meat.”

lines.japanese: 「お肉を食べるだって！？」
lines.english: “Gobble up the meat?!”

lines.japanese: こ、この俺を前にして、なんてふざけたことを言うやつだ！
lines.english: How dare he say something so outrageous to my face!

lines.japanese: もはや実力行使も止むなし。兄とは妹を守るために存在しているのだ。
lines.english: This called for direct action. A brother existed to protect his sister.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ私、夕飯の準備しますね」
lines.english: “Then I'll start getting dinner ready.”

lines.japanese: 「サ～ンキュ～！　俺たちも妹さんの準備手伝おうじぇ～イ、アニキィ！」
lines.english: “Thaaanks! We'll help Little Sister get ready too, Brooo!”

lines.japanese: 「兄貴だと！？　おまえやっぱり、小鳩のことを狙ってるんじゃないか！」
lines.english: “You called me your brother?! You really are after Kobato!”

lines.japanese: 「はい？　アニキなに言って……」
lines.english: “What? Bro, what're you talking ab—”

lines.japanese: 「俺を兄貴と呼ぶなあ！　ええい、おまえなんかっ」
lines.english: “Don't call me your brother! That's it. You can—”

lines.japanese: 俺は佐久間安男のポケットからケータイを引っこぬくと、すぐにアドレス帳から彼の自宅の番号を呼びだした。
lines.english: I yanked the cell phone from Yasuo Sakuma's pocket, opened his contacts, and immediately called his home number.

lines.japanese: 「あ、もしもし佐久間さんのお宅ですか？　そちらの安男君が、おたくの冷蔵庫から特上ロース持ちだしてますよ」
lines.english: “Hello, is this the Sakuma residence? Your Yasuo has taken top-grade loin from your refrigerator.”

lines.japanese: 「うオオォいっ！　なにしてんのアニキィィィ！」
lines.english: “Whoooa! What're you doing, Brooo?!”

lines.japanese: 「佐久間君、お母さんが換わってくれって」
lines.english: “Sakuma, your mother wants to speak with you.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あァん？　も、もしもし、俺だけどォ」
lines.english: “Uh, whaat? H-hello? It's meee.”

lines.japanese: 「っせーなあ、肉くらいなんだッつんだよ、ケチケチすんなァ！　金ならあり余ってんじゃねえか！　参考書なんざいらねェから、たまにはパンクのＣＤの一枚でも買ってきてみせろよファック！」
lines.english: “Oh, shut up! It's just meat! Quit being so damn stingy! You're rolling in money! I don't need any more study guides, so try buying me one goddamn punk CD for once! Fuck!”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　ああ、おお。おお、おお」
lines.english: “What? Yeah. Uh-huh. Uh-huh, uh-huh.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ！　そそ、それはナシだろ、だって俺、ただでさえ金欠なのに……あちょっ！」
lines.english: “Wait! Th-that's not fair! I'm already broke as it is... Hey, wait!”

lines.japanese: 「わーったよ、帰るよ！　この大国に飼いならされた棒人形がァ！　アニキの前で恥かかせやがって、ファッキン！」
lines.english: “Fine, I'm coming home! You lifeless puppets tamed by this great nation! You embarrassed me in front of Bro! Fucking hell!”

lines.japanese: 「つーわけでアニキ～、悪ィんだけど今すぐ帰ってこいってうるさくってさあ。お肉パーティーはまた今度だねェ～」
lines.english: “Sooo, Bro, sorry, but they're making a huge fuss about me coming home right now. Guess we'll have to save the meat party for next timeee.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか、それは残念だったな。また今度遊びに来てね」
lines.english: “I see. What a shame. Come visit again sometime.”

lines.japanese: 「まま、またのご来店をお待ちしています」
lines.english: “W-we look forward to serving you again.”

lines.japanese: 「ご来店？　ご来店ってなに？　ブシャシャ、もしかして妹さん、自分をレストランの店員だと勘違いしちゃったあ？　あるある、よくあるぅ～」
lines.english: “Serving me? What's that supposed to mean? Bwee-hee-hee! Did Little Sister forget she's not a restaurant waitress? Happens all the time! Happens to everyoneee!”

lines.japanese: 「でもそんなとこもキュートでかわいいぜプリィ～ん！」
lines.english: “But even that is cute and adooorable, puddiiing!”

lines.japanese: 「かわいくなどないっ！」
lines.english: “She is not adorable!”

lines.japanese: 俺は妹に色目を使う佐久間安男を放りだして、小鳩と二人きりに戻った。
lines.english: I threw Yasuo Sakuma out for making eyes at my sister, leaving Kobato and me alone once more.

lines.japanese: ちなみに彼は特上ロースを忘れていったので、すき焼きにしてもりもり頂いた。
lines.english: Incidentally, he forgot the top-grade loin, so we made sukiyaki and ate every hearty bite.
